Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 3
Reason for Mistake: In the final step (Step 3), the Planner incorrectly stated that "The First Seven Years" was released in 1949. The WebSurfer's search results in Step 1 clearly identified "The First Seven Years" as a 1930 Our Gang short film (released in 1930), not 1949. There is a well-known 1960 film titled "The First Seven Years" starring Sidney Poitier, but the search results explicitly pointed to the 1930 version. Despite the WebSurfer correctly identifying the 1930 date, the Planner hallucinated the 1949 date, leading to the incorrect conclusion that "The First Seven Years" was the more recent film. In reality, Cinesound Varieties (1934) was released more recently than The First Seven Years (1930).
